question: to the Commission Željana Zovko (PPE), Dolors Montserrat (PPE), Nicolás Pascual de la Parte (PPE), Loránt Vincze (PPE), Miriam Lexmann (PPE), Reinhold Lopatka (PPE) Subject:

In the light of the recent appalling act of vandalism targeting the Catholic pilgrimage site of Medjugorje, including the desecration of statues of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the destruction of a place of prayer, as well as a series of previously documented attacks on Catholic churches, shrines and places of worship across Bosnia and Herzegovina, how does the Commission, through the EU Delegation to Bosnia and Herzegovina, intend to contribute to the protection of Catholic religious sites and the effective safeguarding of freedom of religion or belief, which is a fundamental right and a core value of the European Union?

Furthermore, how is the Commission addressing the repeated targeting of Christian religious heritage in Bosnia and Herzegovina in the context of the country’s EU accession process and its obligations to uphold fundamental rights, protect religious communities and combat religiously motivated intolerance?
